name: @perlytiara/tizentube
description: TizenTube is an ad-free and sponsor-free solution for your favourite streaming website on your Tizen (Samsung) TVs.

scripts.build:mods: npm --prefix mods ci && npm --prefix mods run build
scripts.build:service: npm --prefix service ci && cd service && npx rollup -c rollup.config.js
scripts.build: npm run build:mods && npm run build:service

author: Reis Can
